tracks.source: 550-AAG right channel: the Flight Director's loop in Mission Control (not transcribed by NASA)

tracks.label: Public affairs
tracks.source: 173-AAA: Mission Commentary as broadcast (air-to-ground plus the PAO's voice), time-warped onto the 550-AAG clock

segments.speaker: pao
segments.text: Altitude 1600. 1400 feet. Still looking very good.

segments.speaker: lmp
segments.text: Okay. 75 feet. There's looking good. Down a half, 6 forward.

segments.speaker: lmp
segments.text: 40 feet, down 2 1/2. Kicking up some dust.

segments.speaker: lmp
segments.text: 4 forward. 4 forward. Drifting to the right a little. Okay. Down a half.

segments.speaker: lmp
segments.text: MODE CONTROL - both AUTO. DESCENT ENGINE COMMAND OVERRIDE - OFF. ENGINE ARM - OFF.

segments.speaker: cc
segments.text: Roger, Tranquility. We copy you on the ground. You got a bunch of guys about to turn blue. We're breathing again. Thanks a lot.
